login_subtitle: Sign in to start taming your magical cat
login_perks: Free • No credit card • Instant access
tame_cta_subtitle: Catch the flying food. Drop it on a cat. The right offerings will earn her trust forever.
game_leave_text: This cat is not tamed yet. Her points are lost if you go now.
modal_name_cat_subtitle: She was tamed with {points} points of magical food.
dashboard_tribe_full: You can keep {max} cats at once. Release one to tame another.
dashboard_first_cat: You're the first to tame a cat. Be legendary.
dashboard_coming_soon_text: Train, battle, and trade your cat with the tribe. More actions on this dashboard soon.
care_drop_here: Drop food or medicine on her
care_drop_hint: Drag something from the pantry onto her — or just tap it.
sleep_wakes: Wakes in {time}. She sleeps off her hunger and dreams herself happier.
sleep_no_food: No food while she sleeps — medicine still gets through.
sleep_no_games: The cats are asleep. Games can wait until morning.
care_no_food: Your pantry is empty — go on a supply run.
care_failed: Could not take care of the cat.
play_cooldown: {cat} is napping — ready to play again in {time}
play_rules_laser: Move the red dot with your pointer and she will chase it — but she only pounces on a dot that has gone still. Lead her across the field, stop dead, and let her land it. Every pounce counts.
play_rules_bugs: Bugs scurry across the field on their own paths. Tap one and she pounces on it. Fourteen will pass in all, and the small quick ones are worth exactly as much as the fat slow ones.
play_rules_yarn: Grab the ball of yarn and flick it up at her. She bats it straight back down — catch it and send it up again. Every return she makes is one volley, so keep the rally alive.
play_rules_brush: Seven tangles are hiding in her coat. Hold the brush over one until it works loose, then move on to the next. Clear them all before the time runs out.
play_rules_boxes: Watch which box she hides in, then keep your eye on it while the boxes shuffle. You get one pick: find her and the round is perfect, miss and it is not.
play_preference_hint: Every cat has games she loves and games she humours you with. The same score is worth more at a game she loves.
play_game_laser_hint: Lead her with the dot, then hold still and let her pounce.
play_game_bugs_hint: Tap the bugs scurrying past and she will do the rest.
play_game_yarn_hint: Flick the ball at her and keep the rally going.
play_game_brush_hint: Hold the brush over each tangle until it works loose.
play_game_boxes_hint: Watch which box she hides in, then find her again.
play_too_ill: {cat} is too ill to play — cure her first.
play_lost: {cat} lost to {opponent} — but had fun anyway.
auth_error_subtitle: Something went wrong on the way back from Google.
breeding_empty: No breedings yet. Found the first one.
breeding_apply_pending: Your request is waiting for the admin.
breeding_apply_no_cats: All your cats already belong to a breeding.
breeding_forum_members_only: Only members can read the forum. Join with a cat first.
illness_too_hungry: Medicine only works at {satiety}% satiety or more — feed her first.
supply_subtitle: Drag what flies past into the basket. Rare things are small and fast.
